operations.detail: Fresh canonical HEAD, unclaimed owner and absence of all five runtime outputs read back.
Published daemon heartbeat and lock remain stale at 2026-07-16T13:45:53.0433295Z and 2026-07-09T21:25:46.3071327Z respectively.
Stale-daemon stop path audited; PID could change generation after identity validation but before taskkill.
Helper 001 now re-reads PID plus Win32 CreationDate and exact canonical daemon command immediately before termination.
Helper 001 skips termination when the expected generation already exited or the PID now belongs to another process; stop evidence is written to receipt schema 13.
Watchdog 004 captures the wrapper Win32 process generation immediately after Start-Process for later timeout verification.
Timeout descendant snapshot rejects processes created before the wrapper, preventing stale ParentProcessId reuse from entering the cleanup set.
Any wrapper descendant generation surviving root tree termination now receives an individual PID plus CreationDate recheck before cleanup.
Attempt-spawned canonical runner generations also receive immediate generation and canonical-command rechecks before termination; pre-existing generations remain protected.
